title: A real interruption: a charge the user did not make

history.speaker: user
history.text: can you go through my recent transactions

timeline.text: Sure. On Monday there was a payment of forty two dollars to City Water, then on Tuesday a card payment of three hundred and ten dollars at Electro Mart, then on Wednesday a transfer of fifty dollars to savings.
I'm sorry about that. I'll block the card and open a fraud claim for that payment.

expect.why: an objection: the user claims the floor
a finished report of a charge they did not make
